checkpoint_dir.description: Checkpoint path. Accepts a checkpoint-* directory or a run-* directory (the latest checkpoint inside the run-* is used).

framework.description: Benchmark framework(s) to evaluate on. One or more of: pgym, pbc_zeroshot_contact. Both are zero-shot: 'pgym' scores ProteinGym DMS variants, 'pbc_zeroshot_contact' predicts contact maps from the categorical Jacobian.

output_dir.description: Directory where autoeval results and per-framework outputs are written.

device.description: Device override. When None, picks 'cuda' if available else 'cpu'.

embedder_name.description: Embedder name shown in the autoeval report and in its filename. When None, defaults to '<run-dir>-ckpt<step>' resolved from the checkpoint, so two runs evaluated into one output_dir do not overwrite each other's report; a role-named checkpoint takes its step from training_state.json.

zero_shot_method.description: Zero-shot scoring method for the 'pgym' framework. One of: masked_marginals, wt_marginals, pseudoperplexity. Ignored by pbc_zeroshot_contact, which always uses the categorical Jacobian.

zero_shot_batch_size.description: Sequences scored per forward pass. Masked-marginals masks one position at a time, so this batches that many masked positions into a single forward (biotrainer scores them one-by-one); it also sizes the Jacobian batches.

development_mode.description: Evaluate on subsampled task sets instead of the full benchmark. Much faster; use false for final numbers.

dataset_dir.description: Pre-downloaded benchmark dataset directory, passed to biotrainer as custom_storage_path. Set this on machines without internet access. Mutually exclusive with force_download.

force_download.description: Force re-download of framework datasets (use when new tasks land upstream).
